shorts.title: What you will learn: Pointers
shorts.hook: A pointer is a variable that holds an address.
shorts.script: A pointer is a variable that holds an address. Today we meet pointers. A pointer is a variable that holds an address. With it, you can reach another variable from far away. A pointer is a variable that holds an address. You declare it with a star after the type. You give it the address of a variable with the ampersand. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Pointers.

shorts.title: Pointers in one minute
shorts.hook: You declare it with a star after the type.
shorts.script: You declare it with a star after the type. You give it the address of a variable with the ampersand. A star in front of the pointer means follow the address. You can then read or change the box it points to. Think of a key tag with an address. The tag is not the house, but it tells you where to go. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pointers in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.script: The function takes two pointers. T copies the value that a points to. The value at a becomes the value at b. The value at b becomes the old value of a. The caller passes the addresses of x and y. Now x is two, and y is one. This is the C way to swap. Episode twenty-four showed the C plus plus way. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: A pointer to the wrong type
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in pointers?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in pointers? Bug of the Day. We point an int pointer at a double. The compiler says it cannot convert double star to int star. The pointer type tells the computer how to read the bytes. Use a double pointer for a double. The type of a pointer says how to read the bytes at the address. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: A pointer to the wrong type.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Can you change a variable through a pointer in pointers?
shorts.script: Can you change a variable through a pointer in pointers? A pointer walked into a bar. It said, I am just here to point out the drinks. Make an int called score. Make a pointer to it. Add five to score through the pointer, and print score. Write your answer in the comments. A pointer holds an address. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
